chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Exports of Samples / Exhibits
text: 2.63 Exports of Samples / Exhibits (a) Exports of trade and technical samples of freely exportable item shall be allowed without any limit. (b) An application for export of samples/exhibits, which are restricted for export, may be made to DGFT as per ANF-2Q.
